name: Kim Jong-tae
bio:
Kim Jong-tae (김종태) is a South Korean actor born on April 25, 1975. Beginning his performing career in stage theater after graduating from Suwon University, he established a prolific television and film career as a prominent character actor.

His major television drama credits include roles in Something in the Rain (2018), One Spring Night (2019), The King: Eternal Monarch (2020), Do You Like Brahms? (2020), More Than Friends (2020), Now, We Are Breaking Up (2021–2022), and My Dearest (2023).

credits.title: Colony
credits.overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

credits.title: Seven O'Clock Breakfast Club for the Brokenhearted
